title: ID0414894-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2 / R6 313065117053] SECC_DC1_MB_Problem_KF12
description:
SECC_DC1_MB_Problem_KF12
DC1 Outlet not ready - SECC has communication error with PLC
Note: The fw update is not possible. If you want, fisrtly you can try update the charger

Dear Yunus Emre Temel,
Thank you for reaching
out
to eMobility Support. My name is
Vishal

Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center

:
Y2 / R6 313065117053
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
u5Q8MB
Problem Description
: SECC_DC1_MB_Problem_KF12
Troubleshooting
: In the logs we noticed “Error Polling coap” message which indicates communication issue between the SECC lite and PLC. We will try to connect with the charger remotely to check the SECC Lite, as in the new EcoG firmware this issue can be fixed. But if we are unable to connect with SECC lite, then a site visit will be required to check the connections. We will keep you posted on this topic.
For future reference, your case number is
0414894
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vishal Dhiman
